name: Tanyptera Grants
summary: Small grants for invertebrate surveys, recording, training, equipment and hands-on habitat creation to support invertebrate conservation in North West England; individuals, recording groups and organisations can apply.

geography.label: Cheshire, Lancashire, Merseyside and Greater Manchester

eligibility.rule: The project is not marine, already completed or a duplicate of a successful application
Applicants for training or resources are based within NW England
For habitat creation or enhancement, work on public land and set up surveillance recording.

status.quote: We want to help you support invertebrate conservation and recording in North West England - please do apply.

applicant_types.quote: Individuals, recording groups and conservation organisations

geography.quote: This should relate to Cheshire, Lancashire, Merseyside and Greater Manchester.

amount.quote: Normally up to £1,000, but more ambitious projects will be considered

access.quote: Individuals, groups and not-for-profit recording organisations are encouraged to apply.

administered_by.quote: This site is a product of the Tanyptera Project at National Museums Liverpool. The project is funded externally by Tanyptera Trust.

effort.quote: A decision will be made by the Tanyptera Project Steering Group within three weeks of an application being submitted.

eligibility.quote: We are sorry but we do not fund marine projects, activities that have already taken place or proposals which duplicate previous successful applications.
Support training and other personal development for people based in NW England. Assist with the purchase of equipment and reference books for people based in NW England.
Creating or enhancing invertebrate habitats on public land and setting up surveillance recording to measure benefits.

after_award.quote: An annual update will be required for projects spanning more than one year.
